sentence: This project teaches robots to handle objects by combining generative AI with model predictive control, which replans robot motion in real time.
This project uses synchrotron imaging and diffraction to see how ultrasonic vibration during laser additive manufacturing affects melting and microstructure in metallic components.
This project studies a wrist-worn interface that turns wrist and forearm signals into simple digital commands for controlling smart devices.
This project builds sensing technologies to watch the characteristics of three-dimensional groups of nervous system cells, called neural organoids, as they grow.
This project studies the role of artificial intelligence and machine learning in critical infrastructure systems that must work in hazardous, compromised environments.
This project tries to find out which viruses infect which marine cyanobacteria and how these virus-host interactions shape ocean ecosystems.
This project tries to find out how iron and manganese reactions release carbon from woodchip media so bacteria in woodchip bioreactors remove nitrate from runoff.
This project weaves data science and artificial intelligence into mechanical engineering courses on materials, manufacturing and engineering design.
This project gets a transmission electron microscope that makes high-resolution three-dimensional images of cells and tissues.
This project designs quantum algorithms and quantum machine learning methods so quantum applications can run on realistic quantum machines.
This project tests how bacteria that rely on each other survive and evolve resistance to antibiotic combinations.
This project studies von Neumann algebras, which are collections of infinite matrices, and tries to sort them using group theory and model theory.
This project builds blood vessel chips to watch single platelets under controlled flow and drug treatment and to understand how blood clots form.
This project builds a microscale device that takes nitric oxide from single cells and turns it into a stable molecule for mass spectrometry.
This project studies how users learn to control neural interfaces and uses what it finds to design better computer algorithms for them.
This project studies how nutrient transport and mechanical stress shape the growth of bacterial biofilms using confocal imaging and theoretical models.
